title: Nuevo modelo open source: Audio8-TTS-Realistic-0.6b

body:
Audio8-TTS-Realistic-0.6B builds on Audio8-TTS-Preview-0.6b, delivering substantially improved speech realism while retaining its compact 0.6B architecture and zero-shot voice cloning capabilities.

## Ficha rápida

- Edge0/Audio8-TTS-Realistic-0.6b
- 0.6B parámetros
- VRAM mínima estimada 0.7 GB (CPU / móvil)
- licencia apache-2.0
- 185 likes en Hugging Face

## Descripción original

Listen to Audio8-TTS-Realistic: expressive speech in a compact 0.6B model, with 23 supported languages. Explore 24 examples alongside Preview, Breeze-TTS-2, Qwen3-TTS and Higgs TTS 3.

Enlaces: código: https://github.com/Edge0-AI/Audio8_TTS · proyecto: https://edge0-ai.github.io/Audio8_TTS/realistic-0.6b/ · pesos: https://huggingface.co/Edge0/Audio8-TTS-Realistic-0.6b, https://huggingface.co/BreezeBlue/Breeze-TTS-2, https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base, https://huggingface.co/bosonai/higgs-tts-3-4b Mencionado en: AI Search: AI finally sleeps, Gemini 4 Carbon, ETH cracked, energy-based models, Anthropic IPO: AI NEWS

Audio8-TTS-Realistic-0.6B builds on Preview with substantially improved speech realism, retaining the same compact 0.6B architecture and zero-shot voice cloning. It supports 23 languages, adding 12 languages compared with Preview.

Audio8 is also participating in TTS Arena, where it has received encouraging ratings from listeners. We are grateful to everyone who has listened and voted.
